name: june-ai-receptionist
description: June AI Receptionist — answers business phone lines 24/7 for home-services companies. Books jobs, captures details, escalates urgent calls.

endpoints.name: get_call_log
endpoints.description: Retrieve recent calls handled by June for a business

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — return calls after this time

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of calls to return (default 20, max 100)

endpoints.name: get_call_detail
endpoints.description: Retrieve full details and transcript for a single call

endpoints.name: get_business_config
endpoints.description: Retrieve the current configuration for a business (hours, services, FAQs)

endpoints.name: update_business_config
endpoints.description: Update business configuration (hours, services, FAQs, escalation rules)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Partial config object with fields to update

endpoints.name: get_jobs
endpoints.description: Retrieve jobs booked by June on behalf of the business

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, confirmed, cancelled
